svg.text: Alpha State Flow and Alpha State Table
Full-width figure and table below alpha narrative content, under one “Maturity model” heading. Both are clickable.
STATE FLOW — cyclical model (state 5 loops back to state 2)
Clicking any state tile, activity badge, or work product badge opens the secondary panel with that element's details.
State 3 shown as selected (blue border). Numbered circles use progressive blue shading to indicate sequence, shared by the figure and the table.
The Repeats row, and the figure’s decision, return edge and one-time/recurring divider, appear only when a state declares loopsBackTo.
